title: Census of dispatch templates and skills text for the unexecutable "report before acting" fence form, now that the executability criterion is landed
body:
Opened by the skills lane seat (session `session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1`) exactly as the #14031 ruling fenced it: *"The census of existing dispatch templates stays fenced off as a separate card, to be opened only after this lands."* It landed — PR #14697 merged 2026-09-03 00:0xZ with the criterion in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` (the merged stop-condition bullet). Unassigned; no `domain:*` label by design — triage grades it.

## What to count

Every instruction, in the surfaces below, that is addressed to a one-shot `os-dev` (or any non-interactive executor) and whose demanded action is **not terminal within the run** — the 「先报告 / 先确认 / 先问,再继续」 form the #14031 card measured and the triage sharpened: it presupposes a mid-run channel the executor does not have, and so hands the whole three-way choice (do and report / don't / decide alone) to the executor the author thought they had fenced.

Surfaces, in this order: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `references/**` (the dispatch-word construction section is the anchor, so the census starts beside it), `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/*.md`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, the published `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/**` (entry + `rules/`), and the four small internal skills under `.claude/skills/`.

## What the deliverable is

1. A measured list — `file:line`, the sentence verbatim, and which of the two executable forms it becomes (allow-with-trace: "make the minimal edit and list the judgement and the rollback in the report"; or forbid: "do not touch it; let the gate stay red there and name the site in the report").
2. The rewrites, in the same PR family, one PR per governed surface, each **shrink-or-neutral** under the line ratchet (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`) and the token ratchet (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`) — an executable form is usually shorter than the form it replaces. ⛔ No ceiling raise; ⛔ no re-wrap funding.
3. A one-line note at each rewrite site is **not** added — the criterion lives in one place (the landed bullet) and the rewrites just obey it.

## What it is not

⛔ Not a second ruling on the criterion (ruled A on #14031, landed in #14697). ⛔ Not a change to what any fence *means* — only to its form. ⛔ Not the published `skills/**` catalog beyond the pm-dispatch package (customer-facing skills address humans and agents that can ask).

Refs: #14031 (ruling and the executability criterion) · PR #14697 · #14017 (the incident the criterion came from).
